name: New Password Rejected
summary: The anonymous user has valid recovery authority but the submitted replacement password cannot be accepted, so no credential change occurs and the client remains on the new-password view for correction and retry.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.password.reset.complete is visible with password-reset authority established by successful recovery-code verification

inputs.name: New Password
inputs.description: Replacement password that is rejected by validation, password policy, or the identity reset operation.

serverInteraction.intent: Attempt password replacement using established reset authority, preserve the existing credential when replacement fails, and return the user to the new-password state with a correctable failure.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.password.reset.complete remains visible, the previous password credential remains unchanged, and recovery authority may be retried according to server policy

sourceReferences.note: FailedReset_Should_ReturnFailure_WithoutRecordingCompletion proves that completion can fail after valid reset authority has been established.
Completion rejection is distinct from recovery-code rejection because it begins after successful proof verification and remains on the new-password surface.
